title: Gibson Flatwound Electric Bass Strings, Long Scale, Light Gauge

long_description.body:
Inspired by the first generation of electric bass strings, Gibson Flatwound Electric Bass Strings start with a hex-shaped, tinned steel core for strength and are finished with a flat, stainless steel ribbon wrap. This construction leaves very little space in between wraps, producing a rich, mellow tone while reducing noise from finger movement. Whether you’re chasing the Motown sound or want a smoother feel across the fretboard with less finger squeak, these strings help build a warm, full bass foundation.



The hex-shaped, tinned steel core provides durability, while the flat, stainless steel ribbon wrap brings the timeless warm voice of vintage Gibson basses into the present
Precision-polished for authentic flatwound feel and sound
Inspired by the feel and tone of upright gut strings, but with the added power and clarity of stainless steel
Made in the USA
Long Scale, Light Gauge: .040, .060, .075, .095
Long Scale, Medium Gauge: .045, .065, .080, .100
Short Scale, Light Gauge: .040, .060, .075, .095
Short Scale, Medium Gauge: .045, .065, .080, .100
